text: dsh-webui-m3e 是面向手机的 DSH Material 3 Expressive 网页界面插件，可在原有 Web Host 的 /m3e 路径提供独立界面，并保留标准界面供用户按设备切换。它接入 Host 的 webServer 与登录认证，在设置中提供切换入口。界面围绕会话浏览、聊天与待处理交互组织，并在启动失败时显示恢复提示。适合希望通过手机浏览器使用 DSH 的用户；需要兼容的 DSH Web Host。

dsh-webui-m3e provides a Material 3 mobile DSH interface at /m3e beside the standard UI. It uses the Host server and sign-in flow, with a Settings switch for per-device selection. The app presents conversations and offers recovery links after startup errors. A compatible DSH Web Host is required.
想用手机浏览器操作 DSH 会话。
有没有适合手机屏幕的 DSH 网页界面？
让 DSH 在保留原界面的同时提供移动端界面。
我想在每台设备上单独选择使用哪个 DSH 界面。
怎么从 DSH 设置里切换到手机界面？
DSH 的手机页面启动失败时，能给我恢复指引吗？
I want to manage my DSH conversations from a phone browser.
Can I use a mobile-friendly web interface alongside the standard DSH UI?
界面「手机端 DSH」：插件在 Host 的 /m3e 路径提供 M3E 网页入口，并保留标准界面。用户可从设置或 URL 选择界面。
界面「按设备切换」：标准设置页加入本设备的 M3E 开关，切换选择写入浏览器 cookie，并可跳转到 M3E 页面。
会话「移动端会话与聊天」：前端启动 DSH 客户端并挂载应用路由，用户可在手机网页中使用该独立界面查看和操作会话。
恢复「启动错误提示」：前端区分离线、Host 不兼容及其他启动错误，提供重试和返回标准界面的入口。
dsh-webui-m3e 使用与 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 对齐的内部客户端库；项目代码将该版本作为支持版本，安装时需匹配此 DSH 版本。

> [!WARNING]
> This project is archived and will receive no further updates. Please use [kuraneko1/dsh-mobile-maxxing](https://github.com/kuraneko1/dsh-mobile-maxxing) instead.

A Material 3 Expressive (M3E) mobile Web UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), so you can use DSH comfortably on a phone.

dsh-webui-m3e README · dsh-webui-m3e：

The screenshots show mock screens. The app UI is shown in Japanese, English, or Simplified Chinese.

dsh-webui-m3e README · dsh-webui-m3e：> [!NOTE]
> This is a personal project and is not an official DeepSeek product. It is under development and may contain bugs. Please use it with care.

dsh-webui-m3e README · Quick Start：> [!IMPORTANT]
> The published release **0.0.9** (GitHub Latest) is built for **DSH 0.2.1-rc.2**. Install DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 with `npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2` and check it with `dsh --version`. **0.0.8 is for DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 only** and does not run on 0.2.1-rc.2. If you stay on DSH 0.2.0-rc.2, install [v0.0.8](https://github.com/AliceSaikawa/dsh-webui-m3e/releases/tag/v0.0.8) instead.

1. Run this on the machine running DSH:

dsh-webui-m3e README · Quick Start：```bash
   dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/AliceSaikawa/dsh-webui-m3e/releases/download/v0.0.9/dsh-webui-m3e-0.0.9.tgz
   ```

`web` is an example, so select the profile that actually serves your Web UI (a misspelled name still creates a new profile, and a successful install alone does not confirm the target).

2. Open the sign-in URL printed by `dsh web` to sign in to the standard interface (DSH's own Web UI).

dsh-webui-m3e README · Quick Start：3. Open `http://<host>/m3e/` on the same address. If it returns 404, restart that profile's Host. Restarting the Host (stop `dsh web` with Ctrl+C and start it again with the same command) can change the sign-in URL, so repeat from step 2.

dsh-webui-m3e README · Quick Start：M3E is not published to the npm registry, so installing by name with `add dsh-webui-m3e` is unavailable. M3E has no additional runtime packages to install, and you do not need its source, a local build, or its development dependencies. Always restart the Host after an update or rollback, because that switches the Host code between versions.

dsh-webui-m3e README · Features：> [!NOTE]
> This section describes 0.0.9 and main. 0.0.8 does not have pinning, archived-session display and restore, base color selection, the plugin list, the shared error screens, or the Modes page in Settings.

dsh-webui-m3e README · Features：- **Conversations:** Read AI responses, tool results, and reasoning at phone width. You can also switch to a chronological trace view (「トレース」 in the app).
- **Session list:** Pin conversations to the top of the list. Pins are shared across all workspaces, and changes made in the standard interface or on other devices are reflected too. You can show archived conversations by switching the list filter, and restore one from the long-press menu.
- **Responses:** Approve tools, answer AI questions, and review plans from a bottom sheet, whatever screen you are on.
- **Inbox:** See conversations that need a response together with completed conversations.
- **Composer:** Attach images, reference files with `@`, get command suggestions with `/`, and switch models, reasoning effort, permission presets, and plan mode.
- **Session tools:** Open stats, files, jobs, subagents, and goals from the conversation menu.
- **Search:** Search conversations.
- **Settings:** Manage DSH settings, API keys, and custom providers. The Modes page (「モード」 in the app) lists the agent presets and lets you pick the one used for new conversations.
- **Workspaces:** Switch workspaces f
dsh-webui-m3e README · Features：The existing DSH interface remains available. You can choose which interface to use on each device.

dsh-webui-m3e README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2** (published 0.0.9 and this repository's main)
  - Use 0.0.9 with this version. See Quick Start for installation. Support for the 0.1.5 series has been removed.
  - See [docs/dsh-compatibility.md](docs/dsh-compatibility.md) (Japanese) for results, known differences, and unverified paths.
  - Install DSH itself with an explicit version. npm dist-tags such as `latest` and `next` move over time (on 2026-10-20 both pointed to 0.2.1-rc.2), so pin the version that this repository supports.

dsh-webui-m3e README · Requirements：Check your installed version with `dsh --version`.
- DeepSeek Harness **0.2.0-rc.2** (when using 0.0.8)
  - Use [v0.0.8](https://github.com/AliceSaikawa/dsh-webui-m3e/releases/tag/v0.0.8) with this version. 0.0.9 does not run on 0.2.0-rc.2.
- Node.js that meets DSH's and pnpm's requirements, and pnpm on PATH (used by the regular npm-installed DSH CLI).
  - DSH itself declares no minimum Node version, but its CLI dependency commander 15 requires Node `>=22.12.0`, and pnpm 11.17.0 requires `>=22.13`. Use Node that meets both DSH's and your pnpm version's requirements.
- The tested environment is macOS 27.2, Node.js 26.7.0 and pnpm 11.17.0; those dependency declarations do not establish M3E's minimum supported Node version.
- The DSH Desktop app has not been verified for this release in this environment. There is an [upstream bundled-pnpm path](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/apps/desktop/README.md#bundled-command-runtime), but keep it separate from the regular CLI results.

dsh-webui-m3e README · Usage：Installation, signing in to the standard interface, and opening `http://<host>/m3e/` are covered in Quick Start.

On iPhone, choose "Add to Home Screen" from Safari's Share menu to open it like an app. On a real device, only opening it in Safari has been confirmed; behavior as a Web app added to the Home Screen is not verified.

dsh-webui-m3e README · Switching interfaces：In this README, the "standard interface" is DSH's own Web UI (the URL parameter and the setting call it "classic"). Choose which interface to use on this device with any of the following options. Your choice is saved separately on each device.

- In the standard interface: `Settings → General → Use the M3E interface on this device` (the row follows the standard interface's language)
- In this interface: `Settings → Return to the standard screen`
- Add `?ui=m3e` or `?ui=classic` to the URL

dsh-webui-m3e README · Switching interfaces：On a device where you chose M3E, newly opening `/` on a phone switches to M3E. On a computer (where the main input is a mouse or trackpad), `/` stays on the standard interface; open `/m3e/` directly to use M3E. On devices such as Windows Firefox with a touchscreen, the main input may not be detected as a computer, so `/` may still move to `/m3e/` as on a phone. If you remove `/m3e/` from the URL in a tab that was showing M3E and open `/`, that tab stays on the standard interface. A newly opened tab follows the setting on a phone. In 0.0.8, `/` also moves to `/m3e/` on a computer, and there is no per-tab behavior that keeps a tab on the standard interface.
dsh-webui-m3e README · Switching interfaces：If either interface fails to load, open `http://<host>/?ui=classic` to return to the standard interface.

dsh-webui-m3e README · Updates, installed version, and removal：Read `dependencies.dsh-webui-m3e.version` in the JSON output for the installed version and `resolved` for its source.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web list dsh-webui-m3e --depth 0 --json
```

dsh-webui-m3e README · Updates, installed version, and removal：To update, choose a compatible version from the [release list](https://github.com/AliceSaikawa/dsh-webui-m3e/releases) and add its attached tgz URL. URLs follow `https://github.com/AliceSaikawa/dsh-webui-m3e/releases/download/v<version>/dsh-webui-m3e-<version>.tgz`. This example migrates to 0.0.9. Local-tgz users use the same command in the same profile, restart the Host, and check the installed version above. No manual version editing is needed.

dsh-webui-m3e README · Updates, installed version, and removal：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/AliceSaikawa/dsh-webui-m3e/releases/download/v0.0.9/dsh-webui-m3e-0.0.9.tgz
```

dsh-webui-m3e README · Updates, installed version, and removal：To roll back from a future release, choose a verified compatible version's URL from the release list, add it again, and restart the Host. The same pattern returns to 0.0.9 on DSH 0.2.1-rc.2, or to [v0.0.8](https://github.com/AliceSaikawa/dsh-webui-m3e/releases/tag/v0.0.8) on DSH 0.2.0-rc.2. Do not use the previously distributed 0.0.7 as a rollback target with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2. A saved compatible tarball can also be selected:

dsh-webui-m3e README · Updates, installed version, and removal：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add file:/path/to/dsh-webui-m3e-<version>.tgz
```

Before removing M3E, open the standard interface (`http://<host>/?ui=classic`). After removal, `/m3e/` returns 404, so use the standard interface:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-webui-m3e
```

If something fails, check the following.

dsh-webui-m3e README · Updates, installed version, and removal：- A download returning 404: check the tag, asset filename and URL in the release list.
- Missing pnpm: check PATH.
- A missing UI: check the profile and restart the Host.
- Opening `/m3e/` without the cookie shows a page that asks you to reopen it from the address bar (from v0.0.9-rc.2; the page follows the browser language: Japanese, English, or Simplified Chinese, and English for any other language). If it does not open in 0.0.8, reopen the sign-in URL printed by `dsh web`.
- Failed CLI operations also print a diagnostics path.
dsh-webui-m3e README · Updates, installed version, and removal：For source builds, see the [development and distribution guide](docs/development.md#配布) (Japanese).

dsh-webui-m3e README · Notes：- The UI is shown in Japanese, English, or Simplified Chinese. It follows DSH's language setting (Settings → General → Language, shared with the standard interface), or the browser language when nothing is set. Other languages, Traditional Chinese included, are shown in English. The English and Chinese texts are AI translations that follow the standard interface's terms ([docs/i18n/glossary.md](docs/i18n/glossary.md), Japanese).
- This plugin bundles internal DSH libraries (`@deepseek-ai/cordis` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store`), so it may not work with every DSH version.
- Real-device testing has been done only by opening it in Safari on an iPhone 17 Pro Max. Behavior as a Web app added to the Home Screen, and other devices and browsers, are not tested.
- UI tests mainly use mock data, and the DSH connection is checked with an isolated real DSH and a fake LLM. Behavior with a real LLM is not verified. See [docs/dsh-compatibility.md](docs/dsh-compatibility.md) (Japanese) for the detailed verification scope.
- See [docs/development.md](docs/development.md) (Japanese) for architecture, development instructions and verification records.
dsh-webui-m3e README · License：MIT. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).

> [!WARNING]
> 本项目已归档，不再更新。请改用 [kuraneko1/dsh-mobile-maxxing](https://github.com/kuraneko1/dsh-mobile-maxxing)。

这是一个插件，让你在手机上通过易用的 Material 3 Expressive（M3E）界面操作 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）。

dsh-webui-m3e README · dsh-webui-m3e：

这些截图展示的是模拟画面。应用界面以日语、英语或简体中文显示。 > [!NOTE] > 这是个人项目，并非 DeepSeek 官方产品。项目仍在开发中，可能存在缺陷，请谨慎使用。

dsh-webui-m3e README · 快速开始：> [!IMPORTANT]
> 当前发布的 **0.0.9**（GitHub Latest）面向 **DSH 0.2.1-rc.2**。请用 `npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2` 安装 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2，并用 `dsh --version` 确认版本。**0.0.8 仅适用于 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2**，无法在 0.2.1-rc.2 上运行。如果你继续使用 DSH 0.2.0-rc.2，请安装 [v0.0.8](https://github.com/AliceSaikawa/dsh-webui-m3e/releases/tag/v0.0.8)。

1. 在运行 DSH 的机器上执行以下命令：

```bash
   dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/AliceSaikawa/dsh-webui-m3e/releases/download/v0.0.9/dsh-webui-m3e-0.0.9.tgz
   ```

dsh-webui-m3e README · 快速开始：`web` 只是示例，请指定实际提供 Web 界面的配置档案（名称拼错时也只会创建新档案，安装成功并不代表目标正确）。

2. 打开 `dsh web` 输出的登录 URL，登录标准界面（DSH 原有的 Web 界面）。

3. 用同一地址打开 `http://<host>/m3e/`。如果返回 404，请重启该配置档案的 Host。重启 Host（用 Ctrl+C 停止 `dsh web`，再用同一命令重新启动）后登录 URL 可能会改变，因此请从第 2 步重新开始。

M3E 未发布到 npm registry，因此不能只用名称执行 `add dsh-webui-m3e` 来安装。M3E 无需另外安装运行时依赖包，也无需获取源码、手动构建或安装开发依赖。更新或回退会切换 Host 代码的版本，因此必须重启 Host。

dsh-webui-m3e README · 功能：> [!NOTE]
> 本节介绍 0.0.9 与 main 的内容。0.0.8 没有固定会话、显示和恢复已归档的会话、选择基准色、插件列表，也没有通用的错误界面和设置中的「モード」页面。

dsh-webui-m3e README · 功能：- **会话**：在手机屏幕上阅读 AI 的回复、工具执行结果和思考内容，也可以切换到按时间顺序排列的「トレース」（追踪）视图。
- **会话列表**：可以把会话固定到列表顶部。固定状态在所有工作区之间共用，标准界面或其他设备上的更改也会反映过来。已归档的会话可以通过切换显示来查看，并在长按菜单中恢复归档。
- **回复**：无论当前在哪个页面，都可以通过底部弹出的面板审批工具、回答 AI 的提问或确认计划。
- **待处理事项**：集中查看需要回复的会话和已结束的会话。
- **输入**：支持附加图片、用 `@` 引用文件、用 `/` 显示命令候选项，以及切换模型、思考深度、权限预设和计划模式。
- **会话工具**：可以从会话菜单打开统计、文件、作业、子代理和目标。
- **搜索**：搜索会话。
- **设置**：管理 DSH 的设置、API 密钥和自定义提供方。在「モード」（模式）页面中，可以查看代理预设，并选择新会话使用的预设。
- **工作区**：在会话列表的抽屉中切换工作区。
- **外观**：除了明暗之外，还可以在每台设备上从 6 种预设颜色（紫、蓝、青绿、绿、橙、红）或任意颜色中选择基准色。所选颜色会应用到整个界面。
- **插件**：可以从设置中以只读列表查看已安装插件的状态。
- **错误**：对于渲染失败、不存在的页面、无法打开的会话以及启动时离线，会用统一的界面说明原因和下一步操作。
- **主屏幕**：在 iPhone 上，可以通过 Safari 的「添加到主屏幕」，像应用一样打开。作为添加到主屏幕的应用运行时的表现尚未验证。
dsh-webui-m3e README · 功能：DSH 原有的界面会保留。你可以在每台设备上分别选择使用哪个界面。

dsh-webui-m3e README · 环境要求：- DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2**（当前发布的 0.0.9 与本仓库的 main）
  - 0.0.9 适用于这个版本。安装方法见「快速开始」。已取消对 0.1.5 系列的支持。
  - 验证结果、已知差异和未验证的操作见 [docs/dsh-compatibility.md](docs/dsh-compatibility.md)（日文）。
  - 安装 DSH 本体时需要指定版本。npm 的 `latest`、`next` 等标签会随时间变动（截至 2026-10-20，两者都指向 0.2.1-rc.2），请固定为本仓库支持的版本。

```bash
    npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2
    ```

dsh-webui-m3e README · 环境要求：可用 `dsh --version` 确认本机版本。
- DeepSeek Harness **0.2.0-rc.2**（使用 0.0.8 时）
  - [v0.0.8](https://github.com/AliceSaikawa/dsh-webui-m3e/releases/tag/v0.0.8) 适用于这个版本。0.0.9 无法在 0.2.0-rc.2 上运行。
- 满足 DSH 和 pnpm 要求的 Node.js，以及 PATH 中的 pnpm（供通过 npm 安装的普通 DSH CLI 使用）。
  - DSH 本身未声明 Node 版本下限，但 CLI 使用的 commander 15 要求 Node `>=22.12.0`，pnpm 11.17.0 要求 `>=22.13`。请使用同时满足 DSH 和所用 pnpm 版本要求的 Node。
- 验证环境为 macOS 27.2、Node.js 26.7.0 和 pnpm 11.17.0；依赖声明的下限不代表 M3E 保证支持的最低版本。
- 本版本尚未在此环境中验证 Desktop。虽然有[上游关于内置 pnpm 的说明](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/apps/desktop/README.md#bundled-command-runtime)，但请与普通 CLI 的验证结果区分开。

dsh-webui-m3e README · 使用方法：安装、登录标准界面以及打开 `http://<host>/m3e/` 的步骤见「快速开始」。

在 iPhone 上，可以通过 Safari 的分享菜单选择「添加到主屏幕」，像应用一样打开。实机上仅验证了在 Safari 中打开的情况，作为添加到主屏幕的 Web 应用运行时的表现尚未验证。

dsh-webui-m3e README · 切换界面：本 README 中的「标准界面」指 DSH 原有的 Web 界面（URL 参数和设置中称为「classic」）。你可以通过以下任一方式选择这台设备使用的界面。所选设置会分别保存在每台设备上。

- 在标准界面中选择「设置 → 通用设置 → 在此设备上使用 M3E 界面」（该行随标准界面的语言显示）
- 在本界面中选择「设置 → 返回标准界面」
- 在 URL 后附加 `?ui=m3e` 或 `?ui=classic` 后打开

在选择了 M3E 的设备上，手机上新打开 `/` 会切换到 M3E。在电脑上（主要输入设备为鼠标或触控板），`/` 仍保持标准界面；直接打开 `/m3e/` 即可使用 M3E。带触摸屏的 Windows Firefox 等设备可能不会被判定为电脑，因此 `/` 仍会像手机一样跳转到 `/m3e/`。在显示 M3E 的标签页中，从 URL 中去掉 `/m3e/` 后打开 `/`，该标签页会保持标准界面。新打开的标签页在手机上会遵循设置。0.0.8 在电脑上也会从 `/` 跳转到 `/m3e/`，没有按标签页保持标准界面的行为。
dsh-webui-m3e README · 切换界面：如果某个界面无法正常打开，请访问 `http://<host>/?ui=classic`，返回标准界面。

dsh-webui-m3e README · 更新、版本确认与卸载：查看 JSON 输出中的 `dependencies.dsh-webui-m3e.version` 确认已安装版本，`resolved` 则显示来源。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web list dsh-webui-m3e --depth 0 --json
```
